bullets.text: Delta-delta ratio (AG corrected - 12)/(24 - HCO3-): <1 concurrent non-anion-gap metabolic acidosis; 1 to 2 pure high anion gap metabolic acidosis; >2 concurrent metabolic alkalosis or chronic respiratory acidosis

evidence.quote: \frac{\text{AG}_{\text{corrected}} - 12}{24 - [\text{HCO}_3^-]}

A ratio <1 indicates a concurrent non-anion-gap metabolic acidosis; a ratio between 1 and 2 indicates a pure high anion gap metabolic acidosis; a ratio >2 indicates a concurrent metabolic alkalosis or pre-existing chronic respiratory acidosis
